versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Docs Feeder: auto-fetch documentation for 50+ popular projects.
- Supports fetching by project name (from built-in registry) or direct URL.
- Prioritizes LLM-optimized doc files (`/llms-full.txt`, `/llms.txt`), with fallback to GitHub README if needed.
- Smart discovery of docs URLs for unknown projects.
- Warns users if doc content exceeds 500KB.
- CLI options include raw output, saving to file, and listing all supported projects.
- Easily extend registry with custom projects via `docs-registry.json`.
